facts.fact: The FY2025/26 vote of KES 16.19bn is down from the prior year's original KES 22.35bn and slightly below its final revised KES 16.46bn.

facts.fact: The budget-day digital superhighway package was KSh 12.7bn for FY2025/26, down 22% year on year.
